title: Restraint Policy for Persons in Custody
what_it_is: Restraint Policy for Persons in Custody

sections.label: Restraint policy for arrested persons
sections.summary: Police will generally not restrain arrested persons below 16 or 65 and above, except for serious crimes or escape risk.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have, nevertheless, recently reviewed the policy and have made some changes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We will, as a general position, not restrain a PIC known to the relevant enforcement officers to be below 16 years old or aged 65 and above when the PIC is being arrested.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: But if the PIC is suspected of committing serious crimes like murder, rape or drug trafficking, or if the escorting officer assesses, for example, that there is a risk of the PIC escaping or causing harm to others or self, then he or she is likely to be restrained.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We will have to go by judgements made by officers on the spot.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: This exception policy will not apply to PICs under Prisons' custody, which will include convicted prisoners and persons in remand.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: That means persons below 16 and above 65 will be under restraint when under Prisons' escort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: For PICs with intellectual disabilities, we will treat them no differently from other PICs as they might exhibit non-compliant behaviour and attempt to escape or hurt others without any tell-tale signs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Thus, we will restrain them by default if the PIC is between 16 and 65 years old.
